OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
PALOS VERDES ESTATES, CALIFORNIA 90274
Copies of the staff reports or other written documentation relating to each item of business referred to on the agenda are on file in the office of the City Clerk and are available for public inspection. If applicable, materials related to an item on this agenda submitted to the Council after distribution of the agenda packet are available for public inspection in the City Clerk's office during normal business hours. Any person having any question concerning any agenda item may call the City Clerk to make inquiry concerning the item. Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk at 310-378-0383, at least 48 hours prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.
The City Council welcomes and encourages public participation at the Council meetings; however, to allow for the orderly progression of business, each person wishing to comment or make a presentation shall be limited to up to three (3) minutes. Anyone wishing to address the City Council is requested to fill out a green speaker's card available at the entry of the meeting room. The card permits the City to identify persons for purposes of City Council minute preparation. Please see specific agenda sections below for any other requirements related to meeting participation. The City Council, at the direction of the Mayor with concurrence of the Council, may modify the order of items shown on the agenda.
This meeting will be conducted in a hybrid format, allowing members of the public to attend in person or remotely using the teleconference or videoconference information provided below.
REMOTE MEETING PARTICIPATION INFORMATION
Zoom Meeting Link: https://us02web.zoom.us/j/82138390158
Meeting ID: 821 3839 0158
Dial-In Number: (669) 900-9128
HOW TO PARTICIPATE BEFORE THE MEETING: Members of the public are encouraged to submit email correspondence to CityClerks@pvestates.org before the meeting begins. The email will be distributed to all council members. Public correspondence submitted electronically via email will be provided to the legislative body, but will not be read aloud at the meeting.
HOW TO PARTICIPATE DURING THE MEETING: If you would like to address the City Council during the meeting while participating remotely, please utilize the "Raise Hand" feature during the meeting, or email CityClerks@pvestates.org with (1) the agenda item on which you'd like to speak, and (2) the phone number and/or Zoom display name from which you will be calling in to the meeting.

Recommendation:  Staff recommends that the City Council receive and file the action minutes for the September 10, 2026, Traffic Safety Committee Meeting.
STAFF REPORT
ATTACHMENT 1- ACTION MINUTES OF SEPTEMBER 10, 2026, TRAFFIC COMMITTEE SPECIAL MEETING
5.
CONSIDERATION OF AUTHORIZING THE MAYOR TO SUBMIT A LETTER SUPPORTING CAL CITIES RESOLUTION NO.1 REGARDING LOCAL AUTHORITY OVER HOUSING AND LAND USE DECISIONS
Recommendation:  Staff recommends that the City Council authorize the Mayor to submit a letter supporting Resolution No. 1 of the League of California Cities General Assembly, which calls for a statewide working group to evaluate a state constitutional amendment or other legislative, policy, or ballot-based strategy to restore and strengthen local authority over housing and land use decisions.
STAFF REPORT
ATTACHMENT 1- DRAFT LETTER OF SUPPORT
ATTACHMENT 2- LEAGUE OF CALIFORNIA CITIES 2026 RESOLUTION PACKET
6.
SECOND READING AND ADOPTION OF ORDINANCE 773 ESTABLISHING AN OFFICIAL INFORMATIONAL NOTICE REGARDING THE PALOS VERDES HOMES ASSOCIATION, PROTECTIVE COVENANTS, CONDITIONS AND RESTRICTIONS (CC&Rs), AND THE CITY'S INDEPENDENT PERMIT PROCESSES, AND ADDING RELATED CHAPTER 5.30 TO THE MUNICIPAL CODE
Recommendation:  Staff recommends that the City Council waive second reading and adopt Ordinance No. 773 establishing an official informational notice regarding the Palos Verdes Homes Association, protective covenants, conditions and restrictions, and the City’s independent permit process, adding Chapter 5.30 to the municipal code and finding the same exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act.
STAFF REPORT
ATTACHMENT- ORDINANCE NO.773
